symptom: Users can create accounts and store contacts and call notes but nothing explains processing or lets them erase their data.
root_cause: Compliance pages and a self-serve erase flow were never built.
fix: Publish a privacy policy and add a delete-account control that erases D1 rows and R2 objects (GDPR Art. 17) with an export first.

title: About 100 source files and zero automated tests (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: The scan counted 94 to 101 source files with no test files; regressions rely on manual browser checks.
root_cause: No test runner or CI was ever set up.
fix: Add a core-loop smoke test (create lead, log call, send reminder) and run it before each deploy.

title: 39 icon-only buttons rely on the title attribute alone for a name (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: The scan found 39 icon buttons with no aria-label, so screen readers announce nothing useful.
root_cause: title was treated as an accessible name; it is not reliably exposed.
fix: Add aria-label to every icon-only control and keep title as the tooltip.

title: CTA keyword regex without the i flag missed a capitalised comment keyword
symptom: A post using Comment SEATING was not recognised as a call to action although the lowercase form was.
root_cause: The detector regex had no case-insensitive flag; shipped in v218 and fixed in v219.
fix: Use the i flag (and normalise whitespace) for every user-facing keyword matcher and add a capitalised case to the test list.

title: Unquoted URL containing ? aborts in zsh with no matches found and an empty fetch looks like a hash mismatch
symptom: curl on an unquoted URL printed zsh: no matches found, the empty body hashed to e3b0c442..., which was misread as a changed page.
root_cause: zsh treats ? as a glob and errors before curl runs; the empty-input SHA-256 then masqueraded as a real result.
fix: Always single-quote URLs, and treat e3b0c44298fc1c14... as the signal that the fetch returned nothing.

title: Worklog narration through a zsh variable with stderr sent to /dev/null failed silently for the whole session
symptom: Every narration call failed, the story page showed 6 findings still open, and the finished session (HTTP 409) could not be corrected afterwards.
root_cause: A variable holding a two-word command is one word in zsh, and 2>/dev/null hid the resulting command-not-found.
fix: Call the CLI directly (node path/worklog.mjs ...), never hide stderr on state-changing calls, and check the first call's output.

title: wrangler deploy from a shared worktree shipped another session's committed but unfinished feature
symptom: A deploy for a small fix also published a half-built Speak feature that a concurrent session had just committed, and an auto-commit swept the fix into that session's commit.
root_cause: Two sessions shared one worktree and deploy publishes whatever HEAD plus the working tree contains.
fix: Check git status and git log for other sessions' changes before deploy, deploy from a clean worktree of your own commit, and stage only the files you touched.

title: SendUserFile upload of a 2.1MiB screenshot returned 400 to Remote Control viewers
symptom: A full-size screenshot could not be delivered to a Remote Control viewer; the upload failed with a 400.
root_cause: The relay rejects larger attachments and the tool gave no size guidance.
fix: Downscale or JPEG-encode images below the limit before SendUserFile and report the size in the failure.

title: New token button did nothing when the browser suppressed window.prompt()
symptom: Clicking New token in Settings produced no prompt and no error in embedded browsers.
root_cause: The handler returned early when prompt() returned null, and suppressed prompts also return null.
fix: Replace prompt() with an inline form (done) and never branch on prompt() alone.

title: A 22-app, 285-log bulk sync landed on the wrong account because the saved agent token belonged to the seed user
symptom: The portfolio sync and report appeared under @rhema while the user was looking at @rhe.
root_cause: The saved agent token whoami resolved to the seed account and nothing checked it against the account the user sees before bulk writes.
fix: Run whoami and compare with the expected handle before any bulk write; show the handle in the CLI output of start and finish.

title: Agent API matches project names exactly, so Bug Ledger created a duplicate of the seeded BugLedger card with no way to merge
symptom: A second Bug Ledger card appeared next to BugLedger and the agent API has no rename or delete.
root_cause: Project lookup is a case-insensitive exact match on name and the API is append-only.
fix: Normalise names (strip spaces and punctuation) or accept an alias list in project resolution, and add an owner-only merge in the app.

title: Apps KPI counted non-app buckets such as cross-cutting and Unknown, showing 18 apps instead of 16
symptom: The headline said 18 apps while only 16 real apps existed, and AGENT.md, llms.txt and the checklist totals repeated a hardcoded 18.
root_cause: gen.mjs used appOrder.length in seven places and the order list includes non-app buckets; the number was typed into docs.
fix: Compute realAppCount excluding cross-cutting and Unknown and generate every published count from it.

title: Editing the generated public/bugs.json lost eight appended entries when gen.mjs regenerated it
symptom: Entries added by hand to public/bugs.json vanished after the next gen.mjs run.
root_cause: public/bugs.json is generated from the root bugs.json, so edits to the output are overwritten.
fix: Edit only the source file, mark the generated file read-only with a header comment, and have gen.mjs refuse to run when the output has unsaved differences.

title: The ?demo=1 link only loaded the demo for first-time visitors, so returning visitors saw their old data
symptom: On the live site a visitor with saved state opened /?demo=1 and saw net worth 319,964 and one month of data instead of the demo.
root_cause: Boot loaded the example only when !S.onboarded, so any prior visit masked the demo.
fix: Always reload a fresh demo for guest sessions that are empty or already a demo, never touching a signed-in or populated guest session.

title: Your Data card says no account, no cloud, no tracking while the same app offers accounts, encrypted cloud backup and AI endpoints (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: Settings copy reads as a guarantee that is false for signed-in users and sits beside a footer promise of no bank logins ever.
root_cause: Guest-mode copy was kept after accounts, KV backup, translate and vision features were added.
fix: Rewrite as a factual description per mode (guest: this device only; signed in: encrypted backup) and remove absolute promises.

title: debtPaid sums payments by debt name, so two debts with the same name merge their paid amounts
symptom: Two debts both called Credit card showed the combined payment history against each.
root_cause: Payment lookups were switched to debt.id but debtPaid still aggregates by name.
fix: Key payment log entries and debtPaid by debt id and migrate old name-keyed entries.

title: Deepscan bug-phase total includes category:security titles, so a payload without them scored 298/337
symptom: The first coverage post returned 298/337 with 39 missed items, all security-category bugs.
root_cause: The skill computes the bug total over every catalog title but its prose reads as if security items belong only to phase 2.
fix: State in the skill that phase 1 must list every title (security included) in found or notFound, or exclude them from the bug total consistently.

title: Credit balance fell two to four times more than the listed cost of the bakes with no record of the difference
symptom: Two sessions saw 1,029 credits leave against 483 listed (v1) and 1,728 against about 441 (v2); the rest could not be attributed.
root_cause: Uploads, retries or concurrent sessions are charged without a ledger line per charge.
fix: Record every credit movement (bake, upload, refund) as a transaction with a reason and surface the running total in the CLI.

title: Marketing set shows AI-generated people disclosed on only 1 of 7 photo pieces, with a composite confession quote (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: A 2026 study found women rate an ad lower when the model is labelled AI-generated, yet only the Story carried a disclosure; the pain quote was modelled on a real complaint, not a testimonial.
root_cause: Disclosure was treated as a per-format option and composites were not labelled.
fix: Decide one policy (disclose on every AI-person piece or commission real photography) and label composite quotes as illustrative.

title: apz step used as a read probe re-opened a finished task, and done indices ignore #Wave headers
symptom: Running step 0 to dump state dropped progress from 15/23 to 14/23, and done 2 ticked a different task than expected.
root_cause: The CLI has no read-only task listing, step writes, and indices count tasks while skipping wave header lines.
fix: Add apz tasks (read-only, prints index and status), make step on a done task a no-op, and document that indices exclude headers.

title: Sessions created before the accounts cookie existed were not folded into the account switcher
symptom: After deploying multi-account switching, signing in again showed only the new account and lost the earlier one.
root_cause: signin and signup merged the stored accounts list with the new token but ignored the current gb_session cookie.
fix: Fold the current valid session token into the accounts list on every signin and signup (done).

title: activity-timeline keeps light cards under dark themes
symptom: Dropped into a dark app the timeline cards stayed white with dark text.
root_cause: The module hardcodes light surface colours instead of reading the host theme tokens.
fix: Use CSS variables with light defaults (--atl-card, --atl-ink) and map them from the host theme.

title: theme-studio swatch chips collapsed because the span had no display:block
symptom: The live-preview chips rendered as thin inline slivers.
root_cause: Height and width do not apply to an inline span.
fix: Set display:block on .ts-chip (done) and test the gallery once in a host with a reset stylesheet.

title: GET /api/bugs?limit=1000 is silently capped at 200 with no paging, so agents read a truncated ledger
symptom: A request for 1000 returned 200 rows and no next cursor, hiding older entries from dedupe and harvesting.
root_cause: The list endpoint clamps limit without reporting the cap or offering offset or cursor.
fix: Return total and next in the response and support before=<ts> paging; document the cap in AGENT.md.

title: Inherited 20,000-character clamp on note text would silently cut a long dictation
symptom: A dictation longer than about 25 minutes of speech would be truncated on save while the UI promised the exact transcript was kept; the voice-note recorder also stopped at 5 minutes.
root_cause: The notes routes used clean(body.text, 20000) and a 5-minute recorder cap carried over from short journal entries.
fix: Raise note text to 200,000 characters, the summariser input to 100,000 and the recording cap to 60 minutes (done).

title: Downloaded report HTML kept root-relative /img/ paths so images broke when opened off the origin
symptom: A saved report opened from disk or email showed broken images.
root_cause: The download branch served the same HTML as the web page, with same-origin relative image URLs.
fix: Rewrite /img/ to absolute https URLs in the ?download=1 response (done).

title: Signup returned Cloudflare HTML 500 'Worker threw exception' — PBKDF2 at 210,000 iterations exceeds the Workers cap
symptom: POST /api/auth/signup returned a Cloudflare error page (content-type text/html) instead of JSON; sign-up, sign-in and every auth test failed and wrangler tail showed no logged exception
root_cause: WebCrypto PBKDF2 on Workers rejects iteration counts above 100,000 (undocumented); the throw escaped the route try/catch so no JSON error was produced
fix: ITER lowered to 100_000 and an HMAC 'pepper' (PASS_PEPPER secret) layered over the derived bits as the compensating control; 15/15 backend checks then passed

title: App never signed the user in: bootAccount scheduled on setTimeout(0) before the next script was fetched
symptom: Valid session cookie and /api/auth/me returning the full user, yet S.account stayed null on every page load (silent, no console error)
root_cause: app.js ran setTimeout(()=>{ if(typeof bootAccount==='function') bootAccount() },0) but wire.js (which defines it) was still downloading; the timer fired in that gap and the typeof guard turned the failure into a silent no-op
fix: removed the timer from app.js; wire.js (last script, owner of the function) calls bootAccount() at the end of its own execution

title: Cloud autosave silently dropped writes made during an in-flight push, then raised a false 'changed somewhere else' conflict on a single device
symptom: 14 rapid saves lost the last several; the conflict dialog appeared with only one device in use
root_cause: pushNow() did 'if (pushing) return' after the debounce timer had already fired (no reschedule), and a later push carried a stale rev so the server answered 409 for the client's own earlier write
fix: serialise pushes (dirty flag plus immediate re-push on completion), remember revs the client itself produced and adopt them on 409; genuine second-device writes still raise the conflict

title: Ava (LLM assistant) created reminders and company goals in the past (2024/2025) because the model did the date arithmetic
symptom: 'Remind me next Tuesday' stored 2025-01-07 and 'by December' stored 2024-12-31 while today was 30 Jul 2026, so the to-do never appears; the first fix (pull past dates forward) produced 2027-01-07
root_cause: dayOf() accepted whatever ISO date the model returned; models are unreliable at relative dates even with today's date in the prompt
fix: model now passes the user's own phrase ('next tuesday', 'in 3 days'); dayOf() resolves it deterministically in code and clamps any past ISO date to the next occurrence; prompt states the current year

title: Voice time parser silently returned 10:00 for 'half two' and 'quarter past nine'
symptom: Spoken 'add a meeting tomorrow at half two' booked 10:00 (or failed to match) with no error shown
root_cause: time regex only understood digits; the default-hour fallback hid the failure instead of failing loudly
fix: parser rewritten for word numbers, o'clock, half past, quarter to, bare hours (read as working hours); 15 spoken forms tested. OPEN: British 'half nine' still resolves to 09:00 rather than 09:30

title: Public booking page landed on a day with zero bookable slots (12-hour notice rule emptied today) and derived weekday by re-parsing a formatted string
symptom: Visitor opened /book/<slug> to a wall of disabled struck-through times with no explanation
root_cause: default selected day was today and every slot was disabled by the 12h notice setting; drawDays used new Date(intlFormattedString).getDay() which re-parses in the local zone (locale-dependent, off by a day near midnight) while drawSlots used UTC parts
fix: land on the first day with an enabled slot; one shared parts-based weekday helper for days and slots

title: Ava chat bubbles rendered 35px wide with invisible white text: CSS class collision between message modifier .ava and avatar .ava
symptom: One character per line in the conversation and white-on-white text in light mode
root_cause: message div was class="ava-msg ava" and the avatar rule .ava{width:38px;color:#fff} matched it too
fix: renamed modifiers to is-ava / is-me and rewrote the bubble CSS; chat is now full width (~549px bubbles, dark text)

title: 'New call' button did nothing: duplicate case 'new-call' in one switch, the first case shadowed the real modal
symptom: Button click only reset the recorder; the New call modal at the bottom of the switch was unreachable dead code
root_cause: two case 'new-call' labels in the same handler switch (lines ~803 and ~1157); the first wins
fix: first renamed to 'reset-recorder'; grep -o "case '...':" | sort | uniq -d used to look for other duplicates

title: Photo cropper could not be dismissed and category manager never refreshed: custom overlay ignored the app's [data-overlay] convention and used a selector that never matched
symptom: closeOverlays()/Escape/scrim click left the cropper open and openModal() could not replace it; adding a category did not appear in the manager list
root_cause: crop.js built .modal-wrap without data-overlay (closeOverlays removes [data-overlay]); __redrawCats queried '.modal-wrap.in .modal' but openModal appends '.modal' straight to body
fix: cropper marked data-overlay=1; redraw selector corrected; verified add, duplicate-refusal and reorder refresh live

title: Calendar view crashed on any event kind not in KINDS (new 'focus'/'personal' events, .ics import, hand-edited record)
symptom: TypeError reading 'color' of undefined at calendar.js:176 took the whole calendar view down
root_cause: five call sites indexed KINDS[e.kind].color directly with no fallback
fix: single lookup with neutral fallback at all five sites; Ava's add_event constrained to valid kinds

title: Calendar week view packed 6 simultaneous events into ~15px-wide unreadable columns
symptom: Six same-time follow-ups at 9am rendered as slivers
root_cause: column packing gave every overlapping event its own column with no cap
fix: cap at 3 columns (2 shown plus a '+N more' chip that opens the day), as Finished. does

title: Read-aloud toggle only applied to future replies, so enabling it after a reply did nothing
symptom: User turned on 'Ava replies out loud' after missing her answer and heard nothing; no way to replay a past reply
root_cause: toggle only set S.ui.avaSpeaks (checked on the next reply); no per-message speaker control
fix: each Ava reply gets its own speaker button and switching the toggle on reads her latest reply immediately

title: Customer-facing copy exposed build internals ('See RESEARCH.md in the repo', 'Demo extraction', 'backend', 'in production Hallalu')
symptom: Public users read text that made no sense to them and revealed proprietary process (user: 'this is proprietary and confidential')
root_cause: internal notes written as UI copy and never grepped for before shipping
fix: purged and rewritten as verifiable customer wording ('Every figure Hallalu shows you names where it came from'); 'Reset demo data' became 'Start fresh'

title: Pricing page wedge and stats bank shipped two unverifiable statistics: HoneyBook '+89% price rise' (AI affiliate SEO folklore) and '21x more likely to qualify within 5 minutes' (2007 vendor deck histogram ratio)
symptom: Pricing page and deck asserted an 89% overnight hike that HoneyBook's live pricing contradicts; the 21x figure is a ratio of histogram bars (12,700/1,190) with no denominator
root_cause: stats accepted from a research subagent whose source for 89% was two SEO affiliate sites
fix: both removed; replaced with Xero invoice data (28.8 days, 32,000+ businesses), IRS Data Book FY2025 and a 2025 Hennessey Digital response-time audit; speed-to-lead concept restored with HBR 2011 (1.25M leads) after the critic was verified

title: Compliance warnings shipped with invented or overstated rules: UK DMCC 'gating is illegal', FTC rule 'covers gating', Google LSA per-job review cap, Yelp 'cannot message reviewers'
symptom: Source registry told users the law or platform terms said things they do not; Care.com's $10k/day clause was presented as a ban on keeping contact details; Dribbble's trigger was understated (merely viewing a profile starts a 12-month non-circumvention term)
root_cause: first-pass research summaries written straight into sources.js without reading the primary terms or statute
fix: 6 corrections verified against primary text (DMCC bans fake and concealed-incentive reviews, FTC 16 CFR 465.4 does not cover gating, LSA caps do not exist, Yelp business page may reply, Care.com clause is anti-scraping, Dribbble broadened)

title: AI assistant could execute Business-tier actions (milestones, timers, team invites) on a Pro plan
symptom: Plan awareness existed only as UI gating helpers; Ava's action layer would create Business data for lower plans
root_cause: doAvaAction had no action-to-minimum-plan map; entitlement was enforced only where the UI called gate()
fix: ava-more.js wraps doAvaAction with a plan-requirement map; refusals return an explanation plus the free-week offer (or upgrade once the week is used); calendar still allowed on Pro

title: Milestone back-dating did not change the 'N days since' count
symptom: Editing the date of a milestone left '5 days since' unchanged
root_cause: two unconnected fields: the count was Date.now()-m.startedAt (Milestones.tsx:136) while the date input wrote m.dueAt
fix: startedAt made the single editable source and achievedAt separately editable; 'X days ago' computed from achievedAt; verified day 6 then day 41 after editing to 40 days ago (fixed in the Hallalu port; the Finished. original still carries the bug)

title: Milestone category dropdown did not offer newly added categories (stale closure over the cats array)
symptom: A category added in Milestones never appeared in the milestone form dropdown
root_cause: save() captured an outdated reference to the categories array instead of using a functional state update
fix: categories read through one accessor (myCats()) and updated functionally; verified the new category appears in the dropdown and manager (fixed in the Hallalu port only)

title: zsh does not word-split an unquoted $VAR in a for loop: the repo loop ran once with the whole string, so cd failed and nothing was pushed
symptom: for r in $REPOS; do cd $HOME/$r ... done printed CD_FAIL after one iteration under the Bash tool's zsh
root_cause: zsh keeps $REPOS as a single word unlike bash (needs ${=REPOS} or an array)
fix: moved the loop into a bash script file and re-ran; use arrays or run multi-repo loops under bash

title: UTF-8 static HTML without a <meta charset> showed mojibake when served by python http.server (no charset header)
symptom: em dashes, middle dots and arrows rendered as garbled Latin-1 sequences in the preview
root_cause: server sent Content-Type without a charset and the page declared none, so the browser guessed wrong
fix: added <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first element of the head

title: routine-timetable parser ate the leading digit of a typed time and left the time phrase in the title
symptom: '9:00 reply to messages 30m weekdays' parsed to title '00 reply to messages' with no start time, and '7am coffee and inbox 20m' kept '7am' inside the title.
root_cause: The bullet-stripping regex treated digits as list markers, and the matched time/range phrase was never cut out of the title.
fix: Strip only a real bullet (dash, dot, star, or digits followed by . or )) and remove the matched time/range span from the title; re-ran 13 sentence fixtures.

title: goal-celebrate inferred a filler word as the goal unit ('List 12 new items' -> unit 'new')
symptom: A numeric goal showed the wrong unit label because the first word after the number was used verbatim.
root_cause: Unit extraction took the first token after the number without skipping filler words (new, more, of, the, a, extra, fresh).
fix: Skip filler words and take the next real noun, so it now yields items / orders / sales / $; verified on 6 phrasings.

title: pdf-export turned em dashes and euro signs into '?' (text encoded twice)
symptom: A 'a — b · £5 €6' string rendered as 'a ? b · £5 ?6' in Preview.
root_cause: The WinAnsi encoder ran twice over the same string. Pass 1 mapped the em dash to byte 151 and the euro to 128, and pass 2 only kept bytes 160-255, so 128-159 became '?'.
fix: Made enc() idempotent by keeping 128-255 as already-mapped; verified bytes 151/128/133 survive.

title: Download menu PDF and CSV builders received undefined sheets; zip had no MIME type
symptom: After adding PDF/CSV to the download menu both buttons failed on the live page while the xlsx worked.
root_cause: workbook() returned only {blob,name,tabs}, so pdfDoc() and exportCsvZip() had no sheets to read. SheetExport.zip() also returned bytes not wrapped in a Blob with type application/zip.
fix: Return {sheets, blob, name, tabs} from workbook() and wrap the zip in new Blob([...],{type:'application/zip'}).

title: Modal closed on any click inside it because the overlay carried data-close
symptom: Clicking inside the modal body (fields, buttons) dismissed the modal.
root_cause: The overlay element had data-close and the global handler used e.target.closest('[data-close]'), which matched the overlay for every inner click.
fix: Removed data-close from the overlay and simplified the handler to close only on real [data-close] controls; found pre-deploy.

title: Star Seller sales minimum hard-coded at USD $300 for shops in every currency
symptom: GBP, EUR, CAD and AUD shops would be measured against $300.
root_cause: defaultStar() used minSales: 300 regardless of shop currency. Etsy's primary Star Seller page lists USD $300, GBP £200, EUR €250, CAD $350, AUD $350 (item sales before shipping/tax, cancelled excluded).
fix: Added a STAR_MIN_SALES map keyed by shop currency (other currencies fall back to $300 USD), read from help.etsy.com on 2026-09-03; the About page and report were updated.

title: Sample (demo) owner would schedule sync pushes to the server
symptom: In ?sample=1 mode, edits to the seeded shop would queue /api/sync calls and send demo data to a real account.
root_cause: The store's schedule() and sync() guards only excluded owner 'guest', not the 'sample' owner.
fix: Excluded owner === 'sample' in schedule(), sync() and the post-put reschedule so sample mode never syncs; caught before first deploy.

title: Analysis 'Orders · 30 days' delta compared a rolling 30-day count with the previous calendar month
symptom: The orders KPI delta was misleading because the two figures covered different windows.
root_cause: The delta used months.slice(-2)[0].orders (a calendar month) as the baseline for a rolling 30-day count.
fix: Compute o30p (the 30 days before the current 30) and compare like for like.

title: Sample shop seeds only when empty, so returning visitors never receive new sample content
symptom: After new sample content shipped (banner, logos, second shop), the same browser kept the old sample data and the new features did not appear until localStorage keys were cleared.
root_cause: seedSample() runs only when the sample orders collection is empty, and there is no seed version stamp.
fix: Verification workaround was to clear ev_data_sample, ev_meta_sample and ev_shop_sample. The proper fix is to store a seed version and reseed on mismatch.

title: Per-project and weekly time ignored agent run durations
symptom: The Work Log 'This week' bars and the per-project totals were empty even with 205 logged agent runs.
root_cause: wlProjectTotals() and wlWeek() summed only manual work_sessions rows, and that table had 0 rows. Agent runs live in worklogs (finished/updated minus started), so they were never counted.
fix: Added agentSessionDur(worklog) to both functions and a 'Work & reports' panel (time, runs, reports with links) to the project modal.

title: Account work total inflated to 1148h by boards left 'active'
symptom: The first server aggregate of work logged read 1148h across 208 runs.
root_cause: Duration was computed as updated minus started. 24 boards were left active, so updated kept moving and spans ran to days (max 292h).
fix: Cap each run at 4h in both the SQL aggregate and agentSessionDur, giving 233h47m. A run's duration should come from finished where present.

title: Account totals computed client-side from a capped page of rows undercount
symptom: Any sum of runs or reports in the browser could only reflect the 20 worklogs and 60 reports that /api/state returned, against 205 and 191 stored.
root_cause: /api/state paginates worklogs and reports for payload size, and the client summed what it had loaded.
fix: Added a server-side lifetime aggregate (runs, reports, work_ms) to /api/state as S.totals, with a client fallback for demo mode. Also raised the worklogs limit from 20 to 100 so project runs load.

title: app.js changes shipped without bumping ASSET_VER, so cached browsers kept the old build
symptom: The new KPI tile was missing in the pane after deploy, and the previous task's 'Work & reports' panel had never reached cached browsers either.
root_cause: The shell rewrites assets to immutable /_v/<ASSET_VER>/file paths (ASSET_VER='r52' in worker.js) and the constant must be bumped on every asset change. The saved memory note wrongly said to bump ?v= in app.html, which the rewrite ignores.
fix: Bumped ASSET_VER to r53 and corrected the memory note. The constant could instead be derived from a content hash at deploy.

title: /app HTML shell edge-cached with no Cache-Control, so the plain URL kept pointing at the old /_v path after deploy
symptom: After deploying ASSET_VER r53, plain /app still referenced /_v/r52/app.js while /app?cb=... returned r53.
root_cause: serveHtml() sets Content-Type but no cache header on the rewritten shell, so the edge cached it.
fix: Verify with a cache-busted fetch. The durable fix is Cache-Control: no-store on the rewritten HTML (as done on Evertrue).

title: Live-board ETA rollup undercounted when a wave mixed a wave-level token with a few task tokens
symptom: The header would have shown ~8m total instead of ~60m on the board that carried both kinds of token.
root_cause: etaMins was taskEta||waveEta, so a partial set of task estimates silently overrode the wave estimate. Caught before shipping.
fix: Wave token wins when present (waveEta||taskEta) and the total is the sum of per-wave values; per-task badges still show on each row.

title: Report ship card says 'Deployed: Not deployed yet' for Cloudflare deploys
symptom: A report published after a verified wrangler deploy still showed 'Not deployed yet'.
root_cause: apz report derives the Deployed flag from git state only and cannot see a Workers deploy unless a deploy flag is passed.
fix: Open. Either pass the deploy flag explicitly, or have apz read the last wrangler version/timestamp when building the ship card.

title: worker.js is classed as binary data, so plain grep silently returned zero matches
symptom: grep for 'worklog' and 'live' in the 77KB, 1314-line src/worker.js returned nothing, while the file clearly serves /live.
root_cause: file(1) reports the source as 'data' (non-text bytes), so grep treats it as binary and suppresses matches.
fix: Use grep -a. Find and remove the stray control bytes so the source is text again.

title: Photo AI infers age band, skin tone and facial hair with no age gate
symptom: A fitness/social app runs an AI pipeline that infers age-band, skin-tone and facial-hair from a user-uploaded photo, and has no age verification or minimum-age gate.
root_cause: Appearance attributes inferred from images (special-category and children's-data risk under UK GDPR / Children's Code) were built with no lawful basis, DPIA or age assurance.
fix: Open: add an age gate or assurance, make attribute inference opt-in with explicit consent (or drop it), and run a DPIA. Found in the legal inventory, not yet fixed.

title: GBP prices shown for virtual-currency purchases that are not wired to any payment processor
symptom: The UI shows GBP prices for buying virtual currency although no payment processor is connected, so users see a purchase offer that cannot complete.
root_cause: The price UI shipped ahead of the checkout integration.
fix: Open: hide the prices or label them 'coming soon' until real checkout exists. Found in the legal inventory.

title: Marketing says 'no account, no ads' but the backend has accounts, social and Stripe subscriptions
symptom: The product markets itself as 'no account, no ads', while the backend has full email/password + TOTP accounts, social follows/posts/photos and live Stripe subscriptions ($4/mo, $24/yr).
root_cause: The privacy-first positioning copy was never updated when accounts, social features and billing were added.
fix: Open: rewrite the claim to match the real data flows and align the privacy policy, or gate accounts as optional. Needs a copy fix plus a source-verified claim review.

title: Product name identical to an existing UK registered word mark in class 42
symptom: A live paid product (Stripe plans $9/$29/$99) trades as 'Pixelbake', identical to UK word mark UK00003894245 (class 42 SaaS/graphic-design platforms, Pxlbake Ltd, registered 23/06/2023, plus PXLBAKE UK00003888678).
root_cause: The name was chosen and launched without a trademark-register search. An identical mark for identical services is infringement under TMA 1994 s.10(1) with no confusion analysis needed.
fix: Open: rename before any paid marketing. Registration is not required to launch, but launching under a registered name is infringement from day one.

title: Trader-journal name 'Abba' collides with Polar Music's ABBA registered marks
symptom: The 'Abba' name overlaps the band's registered marks: UK IR UK00801494598 (classes 9/35/38/42 and more, to 2029), EUTM 000620732 (classes 9/41), US class 9 filings, and a s.10(3) reputation claim.
root_cause: The name was picked without clearance, and software (class 9/42) sits inside the registered classes.
fix: Open: rename, or re-brand under a house mark with a distinctive composite, before marketing spend.

title: 'Joy Day' collides with Happy Money's JOY mark for personal-finance software
symptom: Joy Day is a personal expenditure/budget dashboard. Happy Money holds UK 'JOY' UK00003310491 in classes 9/36/42, which covers personal-finance, budget and expense-tracking software, live to 2028.
root_cause: The name was not cleared against classes 9/36/42, and the product sits squarely inside Happy Money's goods.
fix: Open: rename (rated HIGH risk in the clearance lane).

title: Name violates the Git trademark policy on 'Git' as a syllable or portmanteau
symptom: The register search found no hit, but the Git project's trademark policy bars 'Git' as a syllable or portmanteau in third-party product names (GitHub and GitLab are grandfathered).
root_cause: Register clearance alone missed a policy-based restriction on the name.
fix: Open: rename, or obtain written permission from the Software Freedom Conservancy.

title: Several product names shipped without trademark clearance (Evertrue, Kindly, Fullfill, Payrails)
symptom: Register hits: Evertrue vs EverTrue Inc US Reg. 4613429 (class 9, renewed 2025). Kindly vs Convertelligence AS UK00801403375/UK00801530675 (classes 9/41/42, to 2030). Fullfill vs an identical 'fullfill' UK00004405179 filed 21/06/2026 (also US 99908068). Payrails vs Payrails GmbH US 97082130/97082153 (classes 9/35/36/42, pending).
root_cause: Names were chosen from domain or word availability, never checked on UK IPO, EUIPO/TMview or USPTO.
fix: Open: rename or narrow the specification (Evertrue UK-only), monitor the pending Fullfill application, and file COCONVO, HALLALU and APRIZELY (clean on GB/EM/US) first.

title: Apple Color Emoji artwork used as shipped image assets outside Apple's licence
symptom: Where emoji are exported or shipped as image assets, they use Apple Color Emoji artwork, which is licensed only 'while running the Apple Software' (macOS SLA 2E).
root_cause: Rendering or exporting emoji from the host OS font into distributable assets was treated as free to reuse.
fix: Open: switch shipped emoji assets to Twemoji (CC-BY 4.0) or Noto Emoji (OFL 1.1) with attribution.

title: User-to-user apps are in UK Online Safety Act scope with no risk assessment or report path
symptom: BirthdayTreat, GitBagel, Stepapa, Stitchhooky, the Finished. feed and the Hallalu portal are user-to-user services in scope of the OSA. None has an illegal-content risk assessment, a documented reporting/takedown route or an Ofcom-checker record.
root_cause: The OSA applies on a functionality test with no size floor, and a login or payment wall does not remove a service from scope.
fix: Open: run Ofcom's regulation checker per app, write a short illegal-content risk assessment, and add a report/takedown route and contact. Enforcement so far has hit non-responders and harmful sites, with no micro-service fined.

title: apz start --tasks silently splits notes on ';' and '|', creating stray tasks that shift every index
symptom: A note such as 'Diagnose::...(HTTP 200); returning-user boot awaits /me...' became its own task. Boards came out with 7 tasks instead of 6, 8 instead of 7 and 16 instead of 6, so done <index> ticked the wrong task or went out of range.
root_cause: The task-string parser treats ';' (and the documented '|') as separators even inside the text after '::', and gives no warning or escape syntax.
fix: Workaround: avoid ';' and '|' in notes and inspect .aprizely.worklog.json indices after start. Proper fix: only split on '|' outside a note, support an escape, and print the parsed task list on start.

title: Worklog state keyed by cwd is shared by concurrent sessions run from the same directory
symptom: From ~, apz done N returned 'done <index> out of range' and the board tab showed 0/13. The shared ~/.aprizely.worklog.json held another session's Capital Signal board, so this session's ticks were applied to, or rejected by, the wrong board.
root_cause: State lives in <cwd>/.aprizely.worklog.json, so two sessions started in the same directory overwrite each other's active board.
fix: Workaround used: cd into a dedicated project dir and rebuild the state file. Proper fix: key state by session id (APZ_SESSION env or --id) or refuse start when an unfinished board exists in that cwd.

title: GET /api/bugs returns entries under 'submitted' capped at 100, so naive parsers read an empty ledger
symptom: Checking that a POST landed, a parser looking for bugs/items/data reported 'total in ledger: 0' although the entry was the newest of 100 returned.
root_cause: The list response is {ok,count:100,submitted:[...]} with the key 'submitted', each row using 'ts' rather than 'created', and it is silently limited to the latest 100.
fix: Document the shape and add ?id=/?limit=/?q= filters, or alias the key as 'items'. Agents should verify a write with the POST response id or a keyed lookup.

title: Premium third-party Workers AI model (Pruna p-image-upscale) shipped as an engine but fails with 'Insufficient AI Gateway credits'
symptom: The Max-detail upscale engine returned '2021: Insufficient AI Gateway credits' on the first live call, so the advertised best-in-class engine could not run.
root_cause: Third-party models on Workers AI bill through AI Gateway, which is not provisioned on the account, and billing was not verified before the engine was built and advertised.
fix: Failure maps to a friendly 'needs AI Gateway billing - nothing charged' error. Default engine switched to the first-party Images-binding 'Clear' path. Max-detail stays gated and the pitch deck labels it 'ready, needs AI Gateway'.

title: Character auto-describe silently saved an empty identity brief
symptom: Creating a character from a photo succeeded but the brief and traits were empty (refs:1, traits keys: none), so no identity anchor reached later bakes.
root_cause: describeCharacter made one vision call and parsed it as JSON, but the vision model returns prose. The parse failed inside a try/catch and nothing surfaced.
fix: Two-step pipeline, vision to prose then a text model to structured JSON, as the existing describe endpoint does. The resulting brief is now enumerated (eyes, nose, jaw, hair, skin, distinctive marks).

title: Finished bakes silently swap the placeholder for the image, so users cannot tell when a long job is done
symptom: User feedback: 'I don't know when it finishes'. A studio bake replaced the loading tile with the image with no signal, and modal results (upscale, fix, paint) just opened the lightbox.
root_cause: There was no completion state. The placeholder was removed and the tile prepended with no reveal, flag or ribbon.
fix: markFresh() pop-in with a fading 'Just baked' flag and scroll-into-view. openLightbox(id, fresh) shows a labelled success ribbon such as 'Upscaled 2x - Clear'.

title: Upscale via the Images binding is filed as 0 Neurons / $0.00000 although Cloudflare bills per unique transformation
symptom: Clear upscale results show '0 Neurons - $0.00000 - 2 cr' in the library, which contradicts the studio's 'true cost per image' promise.
root_cause: The hidden 'upscale' model has cost:()=>0. Images-binding transformations are metered per unique transform after the free allowance, and that spend is never recorded.
fix: Open. Record an estimated per-transformation USD cost for the Images binding, and a measured or flat figure for the Pruna engine, so the cost ledger and margins stay honest.

title: A solid-black failed generation was filed in the library like a normal image
symptom: Library item 'Amara hyperreal test' (dreamshaper-8-lcm, 768x768) was a 1.8 KB all-black PNG. It showed as a successful bake and was enlarged by the upscaler.
root_cause: No blank or low-entropy output check after generation. Likely a safety-checker or failed-sampler output that was stored and billed as a success.
fix: Open. Detect near-uniform output by byte-size or histogram check, then fail the bake and refund credits, or auto-retry.

title: Open modal survives a hash-route change
symptom: Navigating to #library while the Upscale/lightbox modal was open left the modal on screen until a hard reload.
root_cause: Modals are appended to the body and are not closed by route(), which only swaps the view.
fix: Open. Close open modals in route() or on hashchange.

title: Registry edited in the wrong copy: root modules.json is not served, public/modules.json is, and the count had drifted
symptom: A new module was added and deployed, but the live /modules.json still showed count 26 without it. The plain URL also served a stale cf-cache-status HIT for a while after deploy.
root_cause: There are two copies. The Worker serves ./public/modules.json, but the root copy was edited first. The hand-maintained 'count' field was already off by one (26 vs 27 entries).
fix: Same insertion applied to public/modules.json, count set to the array length, and the live registry verified with a ?v= cache-bust. Longer term, keep one source and generate count at deploy.

title: Whitelist paste sanitiser dropped bold and italic when unwrapping Google Docs spans
symptom: Pasting Google Docs content lost all emphasis even though the user chose to keep bold and italic. Browser test showed boldPreserved false.
root_cause: Google Docs encodes bold and italic as <span style='font-weight:700'> and <span style='font-style:italic'>. The sanitiser unwrapped every non-allowed span and discarded the style that carried the emphasis.
fix: Before unwrapping a span or font element, read its style and re-wrap the children in <strong> or <em>, while still dropping colours, fonts and other inline styles. Verified: bold and italic preserved, no style attributes remain.

title: schema.sql no longer matches the live D1 database (columns and tables added by hand)
symptom: The repo schema.sql lacks columns that production relies on (base_currency and categories on users; pitch_url, category and active_users on projects) and has no CREATE TABLE for reports at all, yet the README tells you to run schema.sql once to bootstrap. A fresh deploy or a restore from the repo cannot reproduce production.
root_cause: Features were shipped by running ad hoc ALTER TABLE and CREATE TABLE statements against the remote D1 with wrangler d1 execute, and schema.sql was only sometimes updated afterwards. There is no migrations folder, no applied-migrations table and no check that compares the repo schema with sqlite_master.
fix: Reconcile schema.sql with sqlite_master from the live database now; from then on write every change as a numbered migrations/NNN.sql applied with d1 execute --file, and add a schema:check script that diffs PRAGMA table_info against schema.sql and runs before deploy.

title: Worker serving index.html through the ASSETS binding looped on 307 redirects, and the 307 stayed edge-cached
symptom: Right after the first deploy, / and /app returned an empty 307 instead of the page. /index.html redirected to /, the Worker handles / first (run_worker_first) and fetches /index.html again, so the pretty-URL redirect bounced. After html_handling was set to none, plain /app kept returning the cached 307 for a while while the same URL with a cache-busting query string already returned 200.
root_cause: The default assets html_handling rewrites /index.html and /app.html to their pretty URLs, which are exactly the paths listed in run_worker_first, so the Worker's own env.ASSETS.fetch call is redirected back to itself. The redirect response is cacheable at the edge, so a corrected config still serves the stale 307 until it expires.
fix: Set assets.html_handling to none in wrangler.json whenever the Worker serves HTML from ASSETS for run_worker_first paths, and fetch the explicit .html asset path. After deploying, check the plain URL with curl -sI and again with a cache-busting query string; if only the plain URL still shows a 307, wait or purge rather than redeploying.

title: DELETE /api/account confirmation body was never read because the worker parsed JSON only for POST and PATCH
symptom: The client sends the delete-account confirmation in the body of a DELETE request, but the worker ignored it, so the confirm check could not work as designed.
root_cause: The request-body parser was gated on request.method being POST or PATCH, so DELETE requests reached the handler with an empty body object.
fix: Parse the JSON body for DELETE as well, inside the same size-capped block (done), or move the confirmation into the URL. Add a test that every destructive route rejects a missing confirm value.

title: Control-character regex was saved with literal control bytes, which broke edits and risks bundler and git trouble
symptom: The clean() sanitiser line in worker.js showed as a mangled character class under cat -v (raw NUL, BS and VT bytes inside the regex), and an Edit whose old_string was copied from it failed with string not found.
root_cause: The regex was written through a file-writing tool that expanded the backslash-u escapes into the actual control characters instead of keeping the escape text, so the source contained invisible bytes.
fix: Rewrote the line with escaped forms (u0000-u0008, u000b, u000c, u000e-u001f written as escape sequences) using a small script and verified with grep -c u0000. Add a pre-commit or deploy check that fails on any control byte other than tab, LF and CR in source files.

title: Inline FALLBACK dataset in index.html drifted from data.json, so a failed fetch showed an older, incomplete record
symptom: The page loads public/data.json at runtime and falls back to a copy of the dataset inlined in index.html. After data.json was rewritten with new faiths, the race and ethnicity lenses, countries and perpetrators, the inline copy still held the earlier faith-only data. Whenever the fetch failed, for example in the local file preview the editor pane opens after each edit, the page silently showed only the original faiths and the lens buttons had no data to switch to. The user reported the lenses as not working.
root_cause: Two hand-maintained copies of the same data with no build step tying them together; edits were applied to data.json and only sometimes to the FALLBACK constant. The first diagnosis blamed browser cache, which delayed finding this.
fix: Make data.json the single source: inline it into index.html at deploy time with a tiny build script, or drop the fallback and show a visible load-error state. The shipped page now also retries the live /data.json with a CORS header; add a deploy check that asserts FALLBACK equals data.json.

title: Headline lives-recorded total sums a single reporting-year count with one-time historical event tolls
symptom: The All-history total (about 8.1 million, and about 12 million under the Race lens once the enslavement toll was added) adds the Open Doors latest-year figure (4,849 for the year to Sep 2025) to multi-decade one-time event tolls from sources with very different methods and ranges, and the per-day rate is derived from that same annual figure. The basis of each number (annual rate, one-time estimate, contested range) is visible only per entry.
root_cause: All records share one events array and the total is a plain sum of the representative value, with no field that marks an entry as an annual rate versus a one-time toll and no range shown on the headline.
fix: Add a basis field (annual, one-time, cumulative) and either exclude annual-rate rows from cumulative totals or show them separately; show the low-to-high range beside the headline total and keep the contested flag visible on the card, not only in About.

title: Undated forward-looking statements (IPO looming, IPO in prep) on a ranking page will go stale
symptom: The ranked board says GCash has a ~$8B IPO looming and Airtel Money has an IPO in prep, with no as-of date, source date or hedge, on a site whose data is dated 2025 to 2026.
root_cause: News-style future events were copied into evergreen ranking copy; the page has no per-claim as-of date and nothing flags statements that describe the future.
fix: Date-stamp every forward-looking line (as of the month, with the source) or remove it, and add a lint step to the deploy script that flags words such as looming, upcoming, soon, plans to and expected in static copy.

title: Rank by value sorts figures that use different measurement bases as if they were comparable
symptom: Re-ranking by value orders Pix (about $6.5T), UPI ($3.5T), MTN MoMo ($500B), M-Pesa ($450B) and Telebirr ($20B) on one scale, although the research itself found MTN MoMo quoted anywhere from roughly $342B to $1.1T depending on basis, and entries mix annual and cumulative values and registered versus active users.
root_cause: One numeric field per system was chosen from conflicting sources to make the sort work; the basis and the disagreement stay in the notes instead of the data model.
fix: Store value as low, high, basis and year per system, sort on the midpoint with a visible basis badge, and caveat or disable the cross-basis sort.

title: Auto-derived slug truncated at 80 characters mid-word on an append-only registry, so it can never be fixed
symptom: Filing the patentscan disclosure created the permanent slug authorship-time-invention-harvester-the-coding-agent-triages-and-files-its-own-i, cut off mid-word. The registry triggers reject UPDATE and DELETE so it cannot be renamed; fixing it means filing a duplicate entry.
root_cause: The worker builds the slug from the title and slices it to a fixed length with no word-boundary logic, and the CLI neither previews the slug nor requires an explicit one for long titles before an irreversible write.
fix: Truncate at a word boundary and cap the title length used for slugs; make pc.mjs print the final slug and require --slug (or a confirmation) when the derived one is cut. The patentscan skill now passes a short explicit slug.

title: Llama 3.2 vision describe fails with error 5016 until the model licence is accepted once per account
symptom: First POST /api/images/:id/describe returned 'Thank you for agreeing to this...' (5016) instead of a description; the Re-engineer, Prompt lab and brand-from-URL describe paths all failed on a fresh account.
root_cause: @cf/meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct requires a one-time licence acceptance via env.AI.run(model,{prompt:'agree'}) before it will describe an image; the Worker called it directly and surfaced the raw 5016 error.
fix: Catch /agree|licen|terms/ errors, call env.AI.run(VISION_MODEL,{prompt:'agree'}) once (swallow its own error), retry the describe, and only then surface a friendly error.

title: Mobile nav drawer stayed open after hash navigation and covered the page content
symptom: At 390px, tapping a sidebar link changed the hash route but the drawer stayed open over the tiles; a Playwright click on .tile timed out because the sidebar intercepted pointer events.
root_cause: The route() handler re-rendered the view but nothing removed the .open class from #side on hashchange.
fix: hashchange listener now does #side.classList.remove('open') before route(); mobile pass re-run with menuClosedAfterNav true.

title: Mobile horizontal overflow on Bulk grid (108px), Connect (532px) and pitch deck (102px) at 390px
symptom: The 390px QA pass reported pageX overflow on the Bulk contenteditable grid, the Connect page (code/CLI tables) and the pitch deck while every other view was 0.
root_cause: Wide contenteditable table cells (min-width 120px, max-width 360px), CLI/code blocks and the pitch layout had no max-width:100% containment and .main did not clip overflow, so the page itself scrolled sideways on phones.
fix: Added a max-width:900px safety block: .main{overflow-x:hidden}, .card/.table-wrap/.chips/.estimate max-width:100%, narrower .grid-edit .cell; re-measured overflowPx 0 on every view.

title: Prompt improver returned 502 when the LLM wrapped its answer in prose instead of clean JSON
symptom: POST /api/improve returned 'Could not improve that one' 502 on a short idea although the model had produced a good prompt; CLI printed pixelbake: /api/improve -> 502.
root_cause: The handler required a parsed {prompt} object; when Llama emitted text with the JSON embedded or broken, d.prompt was empty and the whole call failed.
fix: If JSON parsing yields no prompt but the raw text is >80 chars, regex-extract the 'prompt' field and strip the trailing negative key as a fallback before returning 502.

title: Your-days per-day route read the wrong path segment (404) and the headline printed raw DB kind words
symptom: The new per-day summary page 404'd for valid dates and its headline said things like 'generated, upload, fix' straight from the DB enum instead of readable kind names.
root_cause: The per-day route read the wrong path segment (valid dates returned 404 and the markdown/html formats were unknown endpoints) and the summary headline interpolated raw DB kind values instead of labelled kind names.
fix: Read the final path segment as the date and map kinds to human labels before composing the headline; verified on all four surfaces (web, CLI, MCP, share).

title: Timetable Week, Month, Quarter and Year views were small and non-interactive while Day looked finished
symptom: The owner reported the Day view looked great but Week and the zoom-out views were tiny, hard to use and not interactive (no per-day add, fixed Monday start).
root_cause: Only the Day grid got the full design pass; Week/Month/Quarter/Year were compact summary renders with small cells and no add affordance or week-start setting.
fix: Rebuilt WeekView as a large programme-style 7-column grid with per-day Add buttons and drag between days, added a Monday/Sunday week-start setting honoured by Month/Quarter/Year, soft rounded month cells and a scrollable quarter/year stack.

title: Add-to-your-story ring showed a '?' initials fallback instead of the no-photo silhouette
symptom: Users without a profile photo saw a question-mark/initial in the home Stories ring and the Profile own-story ring.
root_cause: StoriesRail fell back to initials(me) (and the Profile ring to '@') when me.avatar_url was empty instead of the shared person silhouette.
fix: Added an exported NoPhoto silhouette component used as the fallback in both rings, with CSS broadened to cover both containers.
file: StoriesRail home ring and Profile own-story ring

title: Pace calibration accepted a physically impossible result (342 cm per step, 22.6 km/h) without warning
symptom: A tap run recovered the right 110 spm cadence but with a bad distance/step input it saved a 3.42 m step length and 22.6 km/h walking speed and showed it as the user's pace.
root_cause: pace.js never range-checked the derived step length or speed; an impossible distance or step count flowed straight into the saved pace and every later distance estimate.
fix: Added plausibility bounds from gait literature (a sprint stride is about 1.22 m per step, so 1.6 m is a generous ceiling), an implausible-result warning with fallback to the height-based estimate in views.js, 28/28 maths tests still green.

title: Native app displayed the phone pedometer count but never persisted it, so the goal ring, coins, badges, widget and sync never saw it
symptom: Today showed the device step count but the day record kept only manually counted steps; goal completion, coins, badges, the widget snapshot and cloud sync all ignored the pedometer. Move also refused to start until a pace had been calibrated.
root_cause: TodayView took max(store steps, pedometer steps) for display only; CMPedometer readings were never written into the DayRecord, and MoveView disabled Start while the paces list was empty although a height-based step length fallback existed.
fix: Added a persisted deviceSteps field on the day record fed from CMPedometer, dayTotal() used everywhere dayOf().steps was read, a passive web autocount (works with or without a calibrated pace), and removed the calibrate-first gate in web and native Move.

title: Own counted steps and distance were added to the device count, double counting a day (9,620 steps and 6.80 km instead of 9,120 and 6.43 km)
symptom: With 9,120 device steps and 500 manual steps the ring showed 9,620 and distance 6.80 km; the same walk counted twice.
root_cause: The day total summed manual and device figures; steps were then switched to max() but the distance path still summed, leaving a sibling double count.
fix: Use the larger of own and device steps (monotonic, never summed) and apply the same max rule to distance, keeping own distance when no device figure exists; 10/10 and 4/4 checks pass with zero calibrated paces.

title: Calibration taps, which are real footfalls, were not added to the day's step total
symptom: After a one-minute pace recording the user's steps for the day stayed unchanged although every tap was a real step.
root_cause: The calibration save flow stored only the pace record and discarded the tap count.
fix: Add the tap count to today exactly once when calibration finishes (guarded against a double save) in both the web save flow and native PaceLabView.

title: Hero ring SVG was a fixed 264px inside a 203px container so the ring overflowed 29px while its text stayed left
symptom: On a narrow phone the steps numeral and plaque sat 29px left of the ring centre and 'STEPS TODAY' collided with the stroke.
root_cause: The ring SVG had a fixed pixel width while the absolutely positioned inner text box was sized to its container; a cqw-based type scale then measured the whole card (inner 328px against a 264px ring), the --ch digit-count variable never reached the element, and a fit-content wrapper with a 100%-wide SVG collapsed the ring to 0.
fix: Size the ring from one explicit CSS variable on a wrapper that hugs it, drive the numeral size from the digit count and the ring geometry (clear radius 87.6px vs 92.5px corner), verified 8/8 viewport x digit-count combinations with no overflow.

title: PIN keypad felt sluggish: touch-action auto left the double-tap zoom delay and the keys used only 194px of a 248px card
symptom: The owner reported the keypad hard to press; keys measured 59x54 (above 44pt) but taps registered late.
root_cause: The keys had touch-action: auto so the browser waited for a double-tap-zoom gesture, and the keypad grid did not fill the card.
fix: touch-action: manipulation on the keys, a wider keypad (86% of the card), taller keys (64x57), pointerdown registering digits; checked at 320, 390 and 768px.

title: WidgetKit extension installed with GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE was rejected by the simulator: no NSExtension dictionary
symptom: xcodebuild succeeded and the .appex was embedded (124 KB) but simctl install failed with a placeholder-attributes error; the widget never appeared in the gallery.
root_cause: The auto-generated Info.plist for the widget target had no NSExtension / NSExtensionPointIdentifier (com.apple.widgetkit-extension) key that WidgetKit requires.
fix: Supplied an explicit Info.plist for the extension only, moved outside the synchronized folder to avoid a duplicate resource copy, then installed and proved the widget in the gallery and on the home screen with real step data.

title: Xcode scheme resolved to macOS and the build failed on a stale INFOPLIST_FILE reference
symptom: First native build tried macOS destinations and then failed on a missing Info-ios.plist even though GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE was YES.
root_cause: Inherited SDKROOT was auto with macosx in SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS so the scheme picked macOS, and the project still pointed INFOPLIST_FILE at a file that does not exist.
fix: Pinned the iOS SDK / simulator destination, removed the stale INFOPLIST_FILE reference (and restored the GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE lines a substring filter also removed), then built against the iOS 26.5 SDK for an 18.5 simulator with a 17.0 deployment target.

title: Xcode build output (ios/build, 4,007 files) was committed and diverged the local and remote histories
symptom: git push was rejected with 22 local vs 21 remote commits carrying identical messages but different SHAs; the remote's only unique file was an Xcode build log.
root_cause: ios/build DerivedData artifacts were never gitignored, so repeated commits tracked thousands of generated files and later rewrites changed the SHAs.
fix: Backed up the remote as backup-remote, untracked ios/build, merged origin/main non-destructively (a force push was blocked) and re-untracked the artifacts the merge brought back; added the ignore.

title: Calibration offered to save a useless 0-spm pace when the taps were more than 3 seconds apart (web also auto-saved it)
symptom: Native device testing showed 5 taps spaced over 33 seconds produced 0 spm and 0 confidence, yet the result screen still offered to save the pace; the web flow auto-saved a rhythmless pace.
root_cause: The result path only warned on implausible step length; a cadence of 0 (every gap rejected as 'you stopped') was never treated as unsaveable.
fix: Show 'Those taps were too far apart' with the accepted gap window instead of a Save action on native (b.pace.cadence <= 0), and apply the same guard on web with no auto-save of a rhythmless pace.

title: Owner previews of their own share link were counted as recipient views and downloads (and could trigger a receipt)
symptom: Opening a Cloud share link as the owner incremented views/downloads and wrote a link-activity row, so the activity list and the first-download receipt could not be trusted.
root_cause: The share Worker treated every GET of /s/:token and /f/:id as a recipient hit; there was no way to mark an owner preview.
fix: Owner preview requests carry preview=1 (propagated through file, download and zip URLs in share.js); the share Worker counts nothing and records no event for them; verified views/downloads/cloud_link_events unchanged after a preview.

title: File-request links rejected any file over 95 MB because the whole upload went through one Worker request
symptom: A sender dropping a 100 MB video on a request link failed; the sender page promised 'up to 95 MB each' while the drive itself accepted multi-GB files.
root_cause: The share Worker forwarded the file to the drive in a single PUT, so Workers' request-body limit capped it; the drive's multipart path was not reachable from the share Worker.
fix: Added /api/request-mpu/* routes on the drive Worker reached with a ticket scoped to that one request job; the sender page splits the file into pieces with per-piece retry and progress; a 100 MB file landed in four pieces on the live site, folder chosen server-side.

title: Shared links rows clipped their status pills on medium-width windows
symptom: On medium viewports the Shared links list cut off the Last opened / password / expiry pills at the right edge.
root_cause: The row used a fixed single-line flex layout with nowrap pills that did not wrap or shrink.
fix: Rows now wrap their pill group on medium widths (commit 'shared-links rows wrap on medium widths') and the layout was re-checked live.

title: New project would not save and gave no reason: the validation error only appeared on the Type tab and typed-but-unadded row text was discarded
symptom: The owner reported new projects not saving; Save did nothing visible, especially when the user was on another editor tab or had typed a row without pressing Add.
root_cause: The save handler required at least one row but rendered the error inside the rows tab only (and the free-tier PRO.may('count') paywall gave no feedback); text sitting in the row input was never committed.
fix: Show a visible error beside the Save button, auto-switch to the Type tab and scroll the input into view, and commitPendingRows() so uncommitted input is added before validation.

title: Pattern grid cells shrank to a 36px max width with flex:1 and were too small to tap, and count-screen bubbles covered the chart with no way to delete or edit them
symptom: Cells in long rows became tiny and hard to hit; on mobile the transcript bubbles and the dock's opaque gradient covered the chart behind them, and a mis-heard message could not be removed.
root_cause: The cell rule used flex:1 with a 36px max-width so cells shrank as rows grew, and the feed had no per-message controls while the dock gradient was opaque at the bottom.
fix: Larger tappable cells that wrap (rather than shrink) with per-cell stitch labels and a settings toggle, delete/edit controls on each bubble, a lighter dock gradient and a shorter feed on mobile.

title: Interactive cost-compare artifact: the cost-per-prompt slider was mis-scaled 10x against its model defaults
symptom: In the first Max-vs-API-credits calculator the per-prompt slider value disagreed with each model's default cost by a factor of ten, so the 'credits last N months' and crossover figures were wrong.
root_cause: The slider stored dollars while the defaults were in cents (cpp/cps tables), and the readout divided by a different scale; no test replayed the real slider scaling.
fix: Rewrote the calculator cents-based with a full model roster and by-hand vs at-volume modes, then replayed the actual slider scaling in Node for both modes (e.g. 10 prompts/day Sonnet = $13/mo; 1,000 sites on Haiku $500 to Fable $9,000) and republished.

title: Fixed top-right heart/notification button covered page titles and header content
symptom: The owner reported the heart overlapping the information on pages; it sat over title rows and the first row of content on desktop and mobile.
root_cause: The heart was position:fixed top-right independent of the page flow, so any title row that ran to the right edge was under it; attempts to dock it into the sidebar/bottom nav were rejected ('leave the heart').
fix: Anchored the heart in the page header flow top-right (the Finished pattern) and made every title row reserve a gutter for it; an overlap sweep on dashboard and badges found zero elements under it on desktop and mobile.

title: Saved themes and sidebar colour sets could not be renamed after saving
symptom: The owner said they were not letting her edit the name of a theme after saving it; the name was fixed at save time.
root_cause: The saved-themes list had no rename control and the Theme control lived in the sidebar instead of Settings.
fix: Moved themes into Settings as 'Themes & appearance' with a pencil rename on every saved theme and saved sidebar colour; theme names persisted in the settings key the Worker accepts.

title: Mobile bottom-nav 'More' tab rendered with an empty icon slot so it did not align with its siblings
symptom: On phones the More tab showed a blank space where every other tab had an icon.
root_cause: icons.js had no 'more' glyph, so ic('more') returned nothing for the nav item.
fix: Added a rounded 3x3 app-grid icon in the same 1.8px stroke set and bumped icons.js to ?v=4.

title: Mobile bottom bar stays dark on light themes (open)
symptom: On light-background themes the mobile bottom navigation remains a dark bar instead of following the theme.
root_cause: The bottom-bar background is a fixed dark value rather than a theme token (noticed during the heart/More-tab pass and left untouched).
fix: Not fixed - route the bar background and icon colours through the theme tokens like the sidebar.

title: Joy Cloud puts personal data in a URL query string
symptom: Personal data is passed in a URL query string, where it leaks via browser history, Referer headers and server/access logs.
root_cause: PII placed as a query param instead of a POST body / opaque id.
fix: Move PII out of the URL into a POST body or an opaque token; never put personal data in query strings.

title: Shipped with ~30 high-severity accessibility gaps across the web surface
symptom: Scanner flagged ~30 HIGH accessibility issues: icon-only controls with no accessible name, images with no alt, inputs with no label.
root_cause: Accessibility was never a release gate; the six WebAIM-common failures recur.
fix: aria-label every icon button, alt every content image, label every input, set <html lang>; re-run A11Y-* detectors before ship and mirror the fixes to the native surfaces to keep parity.

title: Portfolio scan 2026-10-04: 14 apps have no delete-my-data path, 13 have no privacy policy
symptom: PRIV-NO-DELETE on 14/23 apps and PRIV-NO-POLICY on 13/23 — accounts with no self-serve data deletion and no privacy policy.
root_cause: Auth/account features shipped without the GDPR / app-store-required delete path and policy.
fix: Add a one-tap 'delete my account & data' that purges D1/KV/R2, plus a short privacy policy, to every app that stores user data; state honestly what deletion cannot reach.

title: Portfolio scan 2026-10-04: image/upload inputs with no size/type guard (IMG-DROP) on 13 apps
symptom: File/image inputs accept any type and size with no client-side guard — risks silent oversize failures (data-loss) and billable storage DoS.
root_cause: Upload UIs lack max-size/type validation before send.
fix: Validate type and cap size client-side with a clear error, and enforce the same limits server-side before writing to R2.

title: Worker subrequest limit (50 free / 1000 paid per request) — serial fan-out stalls or throws Subrequest Limit Exceeded
symptom: A Worker that fans out many fetch()/KV/R2 calls in one request either stalls (serial) or throws 'Subrequest Limit Exceeded'.
root_cause: Each fetch/KV/R2 is a subrequest; too many concurrent overwhelm the event loop, too many serial blow latency. (Seen in Hallalu sitemap-candidate probing.)
fix: Batch/limit concurrency (Promise.all in capped chunks), cache, and keep per-request subrequests well under the plan limit.

title: Admin API shipped in 'open bootstrap' mode: unauthenticated until an admin user exists, including product CRUD and billable AI assist
symptom: On production, GET /api/admin/products and the AI assist endpoint answered without any credentials while no admin account existed.
root_cause: The admin guard computed openMode = no admin user exists and skipped the role check when true, so a fresh deployment is fully open to anyone who finds the path (including delete and Workers AI spend).
fix: Not fixed in the session. Fix: require a deploy-time secret or one-time claim token to create the first admin, never branch the auth check on 'no admin yet', and throttle the AI assist endpoint.

title: Public submit endpoint accepted unbounded PDF uploads (storage and denial-of-wallet abuse)
symptom: Anyone with a share link could post an arbitrarily large filled PDF that the Worker stored in R2/D1.
root_cause: The public submission route had no request/body size limit.
fix: Reject PDFs over about 10 MB with 413 before storing.

title: Field font names were interpolated into inline style attributes without sanitising (style injection sink)
symptom: A tampered form definition could put arbitrary CSS into the public fill page via the font family/size strings.
root_cause: fill.js built style strings directly from stored font values.
fix: Sanitise font strings against the known catalogue/characters before injecting them.

title: Standalone meeting-card link carries its whole model unsigned in the URL fragment, and the logo URL falls back to the raw value when safeUrl rejects it
symptom: Anyone can hand-craft portal.html?card=1#<base64 JSON> and have the app's own origin render an official-looking 'You're booked in' card with arbitrary title, location, add-to-calendar link, logo image and email-collect form.
root_cause: Card snapshots are client-decoded base64 JSON with no signature and no server registration (unlike registered pid portals). meetCard() builds the logo as esc(safeUrl(d.logo)||d.logo), so an allow-list rejection (empty string) falls back to the unvetted URL. Text fields are escaped with esc(), so this is a phishing and tracking-pixel risk rather than script injection.
fix: Not fixed in this batch. Recommended: HMAC-sign the card snapshot or register it server-side as /api/portal/register already does for pid portals, and drop the ||d.logo fallback.

title: Private lesson and trade screenshots are served unauthenticated at /api/media/<key>, secrecy rests only on an unguessable key (low severity)
symptom: curl without an Authorization header returned 200 image/png for a lesson screenshot at /api/media/m/<32 hex>.png, the same as with a token.
root_cause: GET /api/media/ is intentionally public so tags and the native app can load it, giving capability-URL security with no expiry, revocation or per-user check; a shared screen, Referer or browser history leaks the image permanently.
fix: Not changed (design trade-off, keys are 128-bit random). Hardening options: short-lived signed URLs or an auth-cookie check for private kinds, plus deleting the R2 object when the lesson or trade is deleted.

title: Agent cat'ed a secrets config (~/.abba.json) while locating a repo, putting the app's non-rotatable pepper into the session transcript
symptom: A Bash call `cat ~/.abba.json` printed the pepper in clear text into the stored conversation transcript.
root_cause: Using cat to probe whether a config exists also dumps its contents; the ABBA pepper cannot be rotated without invalidating every account, so exposure is lasting.
fix: Probe with test -f or print only key names (node -e Object.keys); never cat files named .*.json under the home directory that hold peppers, tokens or keys; treat any transcript that contains one as sensitive.

title: Auth fail-open and shared static cookie: authed() allowed everyone when ACCESS_CODE was unset; docs/files were unscoped
symptom: With no ACCESS_CODE secret configured every request was treated as authenticated; with it set, the session cookie was a static sha256('ff:'+code) shared by all users, every document and file was readable by any holder, and login had no rate limit.
root_cause: authed() returned true when the secret was missing (fail-open); the cookie was a deterministic hash of the shared code rather than a per-session random token; no owner column on docs/files; no lockout.
fix: Real accounts: PBKDF2 + pepper password hashing, hashed random session tokens, owner column on every doc/file with cross-account access returning 404, lockout/rate limit, recovery code. Fail closed when a secret is missing. Open sign-up remains and needs a decision.

title: Unfurl SSRF guard checks hostname only and follows redirects: DNS rebinding and redirect-to-internal bypass
symptom: The paste-a-link unfurl rejects obvious private hostnames but a public hostname that resolves to a private IP, or a public URL that 302s to an internal address, passes the guard.
root_cause: The guard validates the string hostname once and then fetches with redirect:'follow', with no resolved-IP check and no re-validation per hop.
fix: Use redirect:'manual' and re-validate each Location, block private/loopback/link-local ranges after resolution where possible, cap size and time, and strip response headers. Documented; hardening still open.

title: Public unthrottled billable /api/chat with client-supplied context (denial-of-wallet and prompt injection surface)
symptom: Anyone can POST to the booking page chat endpoint without auth or limits; each call runs a Workers AI 70B model billed to the owner, and the page context is accepted from the client.
root_cause: No per-IP/per-page rate limit, no body size cap, and the grounding context is taken from the request body instead of being rebuilt server-side from the booking page record.
fix: Rate limit (per IP and per page, with a daily ceiling), cap message/context size, rebuild grounding context server-side from the page id, and return the FAQ fallback when over budget.

title: pxb login writes the API token file ~/.pixelbake.json with default 0644 permissions (world-readable)
symptom: ls -la showed ~/.pixelbake.json as -rw-r--r-- while the copied ~/.pixelbake-rhe.json was -rw-------; any local user or process could read the bearer token that files and bills images.
root_cause: pxb.mjs saves the token with fs.writeFileSync(cfgPath, ...) and no mode, so it inherits the umask (0644).
fix: Write with {mode:0o600} and chmod existing files on login; audit the other CLIs that save tokens (apz.mjs, worklog.mjs, bugledger) for the same default.

title: Unauthenticated /api/start fetches a user-supplied URL server-side and writes to D1 with no visible rate limit
symptom: Any visitor can make the Worker fetch an arbitrary URL and create rows, so the endpoint can be used to probe internal or third-party targets or to fill the database.
root_cause: The public front door was built for zero friction and only an SSRF guard was added during the session.
fix: Keep the SSRF allowlist and add per-IP rate limiting, a response size cap, a body timeout and a daily write cap.

title: Account switcher returns the raw session token in login JSON and stores it in localStorage for 60 days (also in Breadcrumb)
symptom: A single XSS can read every remembered account's session token and take over those accounts.
root_cause: The switcher design needs tokens on the device and keeps them in script-readable storage, undoing the HttpOnly cookie protection; accepted as a risk during the session.
fix: Keep switch tokens server-side keyed by an opaque device id in an HttpOnly cookie, or store them encrypted with a per-device key and require a PIN to switch.

title: No Content-Security-Policy on any page; inline handlers and the Tesseract CDN block a strict policy (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: The scanner reports NO-CSP on index, landing and pitch; headers now include nosniff, referrer and frame options only.
root_cause: The app relies on inline onclick handlers and loads OCR from a CDN, so a strict CSP would break features.
fix: Move handlers to delegated listeners, self-host or pin the OCR assets, then ship a script-src self policy via _headers.

title: Private investor deck gate was decorative: //_pitch.html and /%5Fpitch.html returned the whole deck and deck.js (34KB) was a public asset
symptom: //_pitch.html and /%5Fpitch.html returned 200 with the full deck; /deck.js and //deck.js returned the payload; only /pitch and /_pitch.html 404ed
